'''Oasis South''' was a small body of water located south of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the desert world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oasis South is one of four bodies of water on the planet Tatooine in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. The other three were the [[Imperial Oasis]], the [[Oasis Northeast|Northeastern Oasis]], and the [[Oasis East|Eastern Oasis]].<ref name="SWG" />
